fields.Summary: Adds an interactive DCR-through-swing-phase widget to the DCR article, built on a pure-JS mirror of `src/affine_control/reachability.py`'s `LinearScalarSystem`/`instantaneous_scalar_dcr`/`scalar_linear_reachable_interval`. It compares an additive-drift and a state-dependent-drift system that share one instantaneous DCR at the phase start but different reachable-interval widths (the same fixture governed by `tests/test_dcr_event_sensitivity_protocol.py`), explicitly demonstrating claim `ad-dcr-001`, and links that claim from the widget.
